**(0401719) The Foundations of Research and Edition**  
(3 Cr. H.)  
This course concentrates on the methods of academic research and the foundations of editing texts according to Muslim scholars in comparison to the Western methodology. It teaches the students the practical steps to the writing of his thesis, its steps, and conditions. It also helps teaches him how to choose his title and how to write the proposal. How to use the cards system and how to classify the chapters of his thesis. The course also teaches him how to deal with a manuscript in academic method, choosing, reading and editing. How to choose the copies, which one to rely upon and how to compare and reference them.

---

**0451720 Commentators' Categories (Tabaqat al-Mufassirreen)**  
(3 Cr. H.)  
This course deals with the meaning of ranks, its importance, the origins of this branch of knowledge, the main scholars who studied and compiled, and the historical stages of interpretation since the time of the Prophet throughout the Companions, successors and their Successors. In this course the student will study the biography, methodology, and the books of the famous exegetes in each stage, their methodologies and directions in their books. Also, the course deals with the circumstances which surrounded each of these stages and the common features of each stage.

---

**0431736 Analytical Hadith**  
(3 Cr. H.)  
An analytical study will be paid to expressions and explanations of certain Hadiths selected from famous authentic Hadith Books, as well analyzing the text of Hadith (Matn) and the chain of narrators (Sanad) in the way that helps the student to reveal the Sanad's issues and sciences as well the Matn's phrases. Expressions, various narrations, additions in its phrases, deduction narrations' benefits and legislative rulings and belief issues. The study will also learn the student the correct way to read the Hadith.
